name: QWEN-ALTTOKEN-CONTROL-0
note: Mechanical projection of PRE-REG QWEN-ALTTOKEN-CONTROL-0 (RESULTS, 2026-08-20), transcribed alongside the RESULTS registration, before any run. BLe-gap-matched non-vendor-head control token at the five frozen HEADSWAP-IMPULSE loci; derivation rule and pinned sources in qwen-alttoken-control-0.params.json; the five control ids are derived on the 3080 and committed into the params sidecar BEFORE any branch fires (driver refuses on mismatch). Runs only on explicit Artin 3080 GO.

BLe.description: single BLe-gap-matched non-vendor control token injected at each of the 5 registered disagreement loci on BLe greedy xhigh replays; qcuda-tower; one branch per locus; HEADSWAP-IMPULSE replay/detector/cap semantics verbatim

bars.name: RECONVERGENCE
bars.description: >= 4 of 5 branches re-enter recurrence (frozen detector, cap-free, fail-closed on ambiguous — identical definition and threshold to HEADSWAP-IMPULSE bar 1)

bars.name: REPAIR
bars.description: >= 1 branch ends with a correct final answer (sympy oracle, independent offline consumer authoritative)

refuted_if: bar 1 counts <= 2 of 5: recurrence-return at these loci depends on which token is injected; the token-generic reading dies and the vendor/control contrast becomes the live object (interpretation asymmetry registered: a low count shows a difference but does not uniquely identify vendor information — the match is BLe head-space logit gap only)
registered_prior: bar 1 FIRES at 5/5 (recurrence-class robustness is token-generic across every perturbation family measured so far); bar 2 NO-FIRE at 0/5. Informative outcomes: any non-reconverging branch, and the orbit color either way
